ContactId.title: ContactId
ContactId.description: Salesforce ID of the Contact record to update. Must be a valid 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID.

FieldApiName.title: FieldApiName
FieldApiName.description: API name of the Contact field to update. Permitted values: Title, Department, Email, Phone, MobilePhone. AccountId is explicitly not permitted. Any other value will be rejected.

NewValue.title: NewValue
NewValue.description: New value to set for the specified field, passed as a string.
